passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “This is the law for the one afflicted with a skin disease on the day of his cleansing, when he is brought to the priest.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
A person may have a skin disease.
This person is called the one afflicted with a skin disease.
There is a law for this person.
This law applies on the day the person becomes clean.
On that day, the person must be brought to the priest.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ זֹ֤את תִּֽהְיֶה֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת הַמְּצֹרָ֔ע בְּי֖וֹם טָהֳרָת֑וֹ וְהוּבָ֖א אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: The priest is to go outside the camp to examine him, and if the skin disease of the afflicted person has healed, the priest shall order that two live clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop be brought for the one to be cleansed.
passages.sermon:
A priest examines a person with a skin disease.
The priest goes outside the camp to see the person.
The priest looks at the person.
The priest sees that the skin disease has healed.
The priest gives an order for the cleansing ritual.
The priest commands that two live, clean birds be brought.
The priest commands that cedar wood be brought.
The priest commands that scarlet yarn be brought.
The priest commands that hyssop be brought.
These items are for the person who will be cleansed.
passages.original: וְיָצָא֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְרָאָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה נִרְפָּ֥א נֶֽגַע־ הַצָּרַ֖עַת מִן־ הַצָּרֽוּעַ׃ וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלָקַ֧ח לַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר שְׁתֵּֽי־ צִפֳּרִ֥ים חַיּ֖וֹת טְהֹר֑וֹת וְעֵ֣ץ אֶ֔רֶז וּשְׁנִ֥י תוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֵזֹֽב׃

passages.text: Then the priest shall command that one of the birds be slaughtered over fresh water in a clay pot.
passages.sermon:
A priest examines a person who had a skin disease.
The priest finds that the person is healed.
The priest gives instructions for a cleansing ritual.
The priest commands that one bird be taken.
The priest commands that the bird be slaughtered.
The priest commands that the bird be slaughtered over fresh water.
The priest commands that the bird be slaughtered in a clay pot.
passages.original: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְשָׁחַ֖ט אֶת־ הַצִּפּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֑ת אֶל־ כְּלִי־ חֶ֖רֶשׂ עַל־ מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: And he is to take the live bird together with the cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop, and dip them into the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over the fresh water.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes the live bird.
He also takes cedar wood.
He takes scarlet yarn.
He takes hyssop.
He puts the live bird, the cedar wood, the scarlet yarn, and the hyssop together.
He dips all of them into the blood of the bird that was killed.
The blood is mixed with fresh water in a clay pot.
passages.original: אֶת־ הַצִּפֹּ֤ר הַֽחַיָּה֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֹתָ֔הּ וְאֶת־ עֵ֥ץ הָאֶ֛רֶז וְאֶת־ שְׁנִ֥י הַתּוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֶת־ הָאֵזֹ֑ב וְטָבַ֨ל אוֹתָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת׀ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽחַיָּ֗ה בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַשְּׁחֻטָ֔ה עַ֖ל הַמַּ֥יִם הַֽחַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: Seven times he shall sprinkle the one to be cleansed of the skin disease. Then he shall pronounce him clean and release the live bird into the open field.
passages.sermon:
The priest helps a person who had a skin disease.
The priest sprinkles that person seven times.
He uses the blood from the bird that was killed.
He does this to the person who is being cleansed.
The priest then declares the person clean.
He lets the live bird go free in the open field.
passages.original: וְהִזָּ֗ה עַ֧ל הַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר מִן־ הַצָּרַ֖עַת שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִ֣הֲר֔וֹ וְשִׁלַּ֛ח אֶת־ הַצִּפֹּ֥ר הַֽחַיָּ֖ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃

passages.text: The one being cleansed must wash his clothes, shave off all his hair, and bathe with water; then he will be ceremonially clean. Afterward, he may enter the camp, but he must remain outside his tent for seven days.
passages.sermon:
A person with skin disease must be cleansed.
He must wash his clothes.
He must shave off all his hair.
He must bathe his body with water.
He will then be clean.
After this, he may enter the camp.
He must stay outside his own tent for seven days.
passages.original: וְכִבֶּס֩ הַמִּטַּהֵ֨ר אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֜יו וְגִלַּ֣ח אֶת־ כָּל־ שְׂעָר֗וֹ וְרָחַ֤ץ בַּמַּ֙יִם֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר וְאַחַ֖ר יָב֣וֹא אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְיָשַׁ֛ב מִח֥וּץ לְאָהֳל֖וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: On the seventh day he must shave off all his hair—his head, his beard, his eyebrows, and the rest of his hair. He must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and he will be clean.
passages.sermon:
A man with skin disease is being cleansed.
On the seventh day, he must shave off all his hair.
He must shave his head.
He must shave his beard.
He must shave his eyebrows.
He must shave the rest of his hair.
He must wash his clothes.
He must bathe his body with water.
Then he will be clean.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י יְגַלַּ֣ח אֶת־ כָּל־ שְׂעָר֗וֹ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֤וֹ וְאֶת־ זְקָנוֹ֙ וְאֵת֙ גַּבֹּ֣ת עֵינָ֔יו וְאֶת־ כָּל־ שְׂעָר֖וֹ יְגַלֵּ֑חַ וְכִבֶּ֣ס אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֗יו וְרָחַ֧ץ אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָהֵֽר׃

passages.text: On the eighth day he is to bring two unblemished male lambs, an unblemished ewe lamb a year old, a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with olive oil, and one log of olive oil.
passages.sermon:
On the eighth day, the person being cleansed must bring offerings.
He must bring two male lambs without blemish.
He must bring one female lamb, one year old, without blemish.
He must bring a grain offering.
The grain offering must be three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with olive oil.
He must also bring one log of olive oil.
passages.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִקַּ֤ח שְׁנֵֽי־ כְבָשִׂים֙ תְּמִימִ֔ים וְכַבְשָׂ֥ה אַחַ֛ת בַּת־ שְׁנָתָ֖הּ תְּמִימָ֑ה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְלֹ֥ג אֶחָ֖ד שָֽׁמֶן׃

passages.text: The priest who performs the cleansing shall present the one to be cleansed, together with these offerings, before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
A priest performs the cleansing.
This priest brings the man who needs cleansing.
The priest also brings the required offerings.
The priest presents the man and the offerings before the LORD.
He does this at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְהֶעֱמִ֞יד הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַֽמְטַהֵ֗ר אֵ֛ת הָאִ֥ישׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר וְאֹתָ֑ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: Then the priest is to take one of the male lambs and present it as a guilt offering, along with the log of olive oil; and he must wave them as a wave offering before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The priest performs the cleansing ceremony.
The priest takes one male lamb.
The lamb must be unblemished.
The priest also takes a log of olive oil.
The priest presents the lamb as a guilt offering.
The priest presents the log of oil with the lamb.
The priest waves the lamb and the oil as a wave offering.
The priest does this before the LORD.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֗ד וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹת֛וֹ לְאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת־ לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְהֵנִ֥יף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then he is to slaughter the lamb in the sanctuary area where the sin offering and burnt offering are slaughtered. Like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest; it is most holy.
passages.sermon:
The priest must slaughter the lamb.
He must do this in the holy place.
This is the same place where the priest slaughters the sin offering and the burnt offering.
The guilt offering is like the sin offering.
The guilt offering belongs to the priest.
The guilt offering is most holy.
passages.original: וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֶת־ הַכֶּ֗בֶשׂ בִּ֠מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחַ֧ט אֶת־ הַֽחַטָּ֛את וְאֶת־ הָעֹלָ֖ה בִּמְק֣וֹם הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כִּ֡י כַּ֠חַטָּאת הָאָשָׁ֥ם הוּא֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃

passages.text: The priest is to take some of the blood from the guilt offering and put it on the right earlobe of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
passages.sermon:
The priest serves in the sanctuary.
The priest takes some blood from the guilt offering.
The priest puts the blood on the person who is being cleansed.
The priest puts the blood on the right earlobe of that person.
The priest puts the blood on the right thumb of that person.
The priest puts the blood on the right big toe of that person.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֣ח הַכֹּהֵן֮ מִדַּ֣ם הָאָשָׁם֒ וְנָתַן֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַל־ תְּנ֛וּךְ אֹ֥זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃

passages.text: Then the priest shall take some of the log of olive oil, pour it into his left palm, dip his right forefinger into the oil in his left palm, and sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The priest serves in the sanctuary.
The priest takes some olive oil.
He pours the oil into his left palm.
The priest dips his right forefinger into the oil in his left palm.
He sprinkles some of the oil with his finger.
He does this seven times.
He sprinkles the oil before the LORD.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן מִלֹּ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְיָצַ֛ק עַל־ כַּ֥ף הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַשְּׂמָאלִֽית׃ וְטָבַ֤ל הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ אֶצְבָּע֣וֹ הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִן־ הַשֶּׁ֕מֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ כַּפּ֖וֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֑ית וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן־ הַשֶּׁ֧מֶן בְּאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And the priest is to put some of the oil remaining in his palm on the right earlobe of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.
passages.sermon:
The priest stands before the person who needs cleansing.
The priest holds oil in his palm.
Some oil remains in the priest’s palm.
The priest takes the remaining oil.
The priest puts the oil on the right earlobe of the person to be cleansed.
The priest puts the oil on the right thumb of the person to be cleansed.
The priest puts the oil on the right big toe of the person to be cleansed.
The priest puts the oil on top of the blood from the guilt offering.
passages.original: וּמִיֶּ֨תֶר הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ כַּפּ֗וֹ יִתֵּ֤ן הַכֹּהֵן֙ עַל־ תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִ֑ית עַ֖ל דַּ֥ם הָאָשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: The rest of the oil in his palm, the priest is to put on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The priest is a holy servant of God.
The priest holds oil in his palm.
Some oil remains in the priest’s palm.
The priest puts the rest of the oil on the head of the person being cleansed.
The priest does this to make atonement for the person.
The priest does this before the LORD.
passages.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֗ר בַּשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ כַּ֣ף הַכֹּהֵ֔ן יִתֵּ֖ן עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֑ר וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the priest is to sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness. After that, the priest shall slaughter the burnt offering and offer it on the altar, with the grain offering, to make atonement for him, and he will be clean.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes the sin offering.
The priest sacrifices the sin offering.
The priest makes atonement for the person who needs to be cleansed.
The atonement removes the person's uncleanness.
After this, the priest kills the burnt offering.
The priest puts the burnt offering and the grain offering on the altar.
The priest makes atonement for the person again.
The person becomes clean.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ הַ֣חַטָּ֔את וְכִפֶּ֕ר עַל־ הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר מִטֻּמְאָת֑וֹ וְאַחַ֖ר יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ הָעֹלָֽה׃ וְהֶעֱלָ֧ה הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֥ה וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטָהֵֽר׃ס

passages.text: If, however, the person is poor and cannot afford these offerings, he is to take one male lamb as a guilt offering to be waved to make atonement for him, along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with olive oil for a grain offering, a log of olive oil, and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, whichever he can afford, one to be a sin offering and the other a burnt offering.
passages.sermon:
If a person is poor, he cannot afford the regular offerings.
He must take one male lamb.
This lamb is for a guilt offering.
The priest will wave the lamb to make atonement for him.
He must also bring a tenth of an ephah of fine flour.
He must mix this flour with olive oil.
This is for a grain offering.
He must bring a log of olive oil.
He must also bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons.
He may bring whichever birds he can afford.
One bird will be for a sin offering.
The other bird will be for a burnt offering.
passages.original: וְאִם־ דַּ֣ל ה֗וּא וְאֵ֣ין יָדוֹ֮ מַשֶּׂגֶת֒ וְ֠לָקַח כֶּ֣בֶשׂ אֶחָ֥ד אָשָׁ֛ם לִתְנוּפָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְעִשָּׂר֨וֹן סֹ֜לֶת אֶחָ֨ד בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן לְמִנְחָ֖ה וְלֹ֥ג שָֽׁמֶן׃ וּשְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָד֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה אֶחָד֙ חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָֽה׃

passages.text: On the eighth day he is to bring them for his cleansing to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
A man needs to be cleansed from impurity.
He must bring his offerings to the priest.
He does this on the eighth day.
He brings the offerings for his cleansing.
He goes to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
He stands before the LORD.
The priest receives the offerings at the entrance.
passages.original: וְהֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜ם בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֛י לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֶל־ פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The priest shall take the lamb for the guilt offering, along with the log of olive oil, and wave them as a wave offering before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes the lamb for the guilt offering.
The priest also takes a log of olive oil.
The priest waves the lamb and the oil as a wave offering.
The priest does this before the LORD.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ כֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת־ לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְהֵנִ֨יף אֹתָ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And after he slaughters the lamb for the guilt offering, the priest is to take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the right earlobe of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
passages.sermon:
A priest serves before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
A man seeks cleansing from impurity.
The priest slaughters a lamb for a guilt offering.
The priest takes some blood from the guilt offering.
The priest puts the blood on the man's right earlobe.
The priest puts the blood on the man's right thumb.
The priest puts the blood on the man's right big toe.
passages.original: וְשָׁחַט֮ אֶת־ כֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָֽאָשָׁם֒ וְלָקַ֤ח הַכֹּהֵן֙ מִדַּ֣ם הָֽאָשָׁ֔ם וְנָתַ֛ן עַל־ תְּנ֥וּךְ אֹֽזֶן־ הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃

passages.text: Then the priest is to pour some of the oil into his left palm and sprinkle with his right forefinger some of the oil in his left palm seven times before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes some of the oil.
He pours the oil into his left palm.
The priest uses his right forefinger.
He sprinkles some of the oil from his left palm.
He sprinkles the oil seven times.
He does this before the LORD.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן יִצֹ֣ק הַכֹּהֵ֑ן עַל־ כַּ֥ף הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַשְּׂמָאלִֽית׃ וְהִזָּ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֣וֹ הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִן־ הַשֶּׁ֕מֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ כַּפּ֖וֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֑ית שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The priest shall also put some of the oil in his palm on the right earlobe of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot—on the same places as the blood of the guilt offering.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes some oil from his own palm.
The priest puts the oil on the person who is being cleansed.
The priest puts the oil on the right earlobe of that person.
The priest puts the oil on the right thumb of that person.
The priest puts the oil on the right big toe of that person.
The priest puts the oil on the same places where he put the blood of the guilt offering.
passages.original: וְנָתַ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִן־ הַשֶּׁ֣מֶן׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ כַּפּ֗וֹ עַל־ תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִ֑ית עַל־ מְק֖וֹם דַּ֥ם הָאָשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: The rest of the oil in his palm, the priest is to put on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The priest is a holy man who serves God.
The priest holds oil in his palm.
Some oil remains in the priest’s palm.
The priest takes the rest of the oil.
The priest puts the oil on the head of the person who is being cleansed.
The priest does this to make atonement for the person.
The priest does this before the LORD.
passages.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֗ר מִן־ הַשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ כַּ֣ף הַכֹּהֵ֔ן יִתֵּ֖ן עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֑ר לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֖יו לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then he must sacrifice the turtledoves or young pigeons, whichever he can afford, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, together with the grain offering. In this way the priest will make atonement before the LORD for the one to be cleansed.
passages.sermon:
A person with a skin disease must bring birds for sacrifice.
He may bring turtledoves or young pigeons.
He must bring what he can afford.
He must give one bird as a sin offering.
He must give the other bird as a burnt offering.
He must also bring a grain offering.
The priest will offer these sacrifices for the person.
The priest will make atonement for the person before the LORD.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־ הָֽאֶחָד֙ מִן־ הַתֹּרִ֔ים א֖וֹ מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י הַיּוֹנָ֑ה מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָדֽוֹ׃ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ תַּשִּׂ֞יג יָד֗וֹ אֶת־ הָאֶחָ֥ד חַטָּ֛את וְאֶת־ הָאֶחָ֥ד עֹלָ֖ה עַל־ הַמִּנְחָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עַ֥ל הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: This is the law for someone who has a skin disease and cannot afford the cost of his cleansing.”
passages.sermon:
This law applies to a person with a skin disease.
This person cannot afford the cost of cleansing.
This is the rule for his purification.
passages.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֔ת אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֖וֹ נֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ תַשִּׂ֥יג יָד֖וֹ בְּטָהֳרָתֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “When you enter the land of Canaan, which I am giving you as your possession, and I put a contamination of mildew into a house in that land, the owner of the house shall come and tell the priest, ‘Something like mildew has appeared in my house.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.
He said these words to them.
You will enter the land of Canaan.
I am giving this land to you as your possession.
I will put a mildew contamination in a house in that land.
If a person owns a house in that land, he must act.
The owner must go to the priest.
He must say to the priest, “I have seen something like mildew in my house.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ כִּ֤י תָבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֑ה וְנָתַתִּי֙ נֶ֣גַע צָרַ֔עַת בְּבֵ֖ית אֶ֥רֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶֽם׃ וּבָא֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֣וֹ הַבַּ֔יִת וְהִגִּ֥יד לַכֹּהֵ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּנֶ֕גַע נִרְאָ֥ה לִ֖י בַּבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: The priest must order that the house be cleared before he enters it to examine the mildew, so that nothing in the house will become unclean. After this, the priest shall go in to inspect the house.
passages.sermon:
A priest serves God and leads the people.
The priest must give an order.
He must tell the people to clear out the house.
They must do this before the priest enters the house.
The priest must not go in until the house is empty.
This prevents anything in the house from becoming unclean.
After the house is cleared, the priest will enter.
The priest will then examine the house for mildew.
passages.original: וְצִוָּ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וּפִנּ֣וּ אֶת־ הַבַּ֗יִת בְּטֶ֨רֶם יָבֹ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִרְא֣וֹת אֶת־ הַנֶּ֔גַע וְלֹ֥א יִטְמָ֖א כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּבָּ֑יִת וְאַ֥חַר כֵּ֛ן יָבֹ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: He is to examine the house, and if the mildew on the walls consists of green or red depressions that appear to be beneath the surface of the wall, the priest shall go outside the doorway of the house and close it up for seven days.
passages.sermon:
A priest must examine the house.
He looks at the walls.
He sees if there are green or red depressions in the walls.
These spots look lower than the rest of the wall.
If he sees these signs, the priest leaves the house.
He goes to the doorway.
He closes up the house for seven days.
passages.original: וְרָאָ֣ה אֶת־ הַנֶּ֗גַע וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בְּקִירֹ֣ת הַבַּ֔יִת שְׁקַֽעֲרוּרֹת֙ יְרַקְרַקֹּ֔ת א֖וֹ אֲדַמְדַּמֹּ֑ת וּמַרְאֵיהֶ֥ן שָׁפָ֖ל מִן־ הַקִּֽיר׃ וְיָצָ֧א הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מִן־ הַבַּ֖יִת אֶל־ פֶּ֣תַח הַבָּ֑יִת וְהִסְגִּ֥יר אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: On the seventh day the priest is to return and inspect the house. If the mildew has spread on the walls, he must order that the contaminated stones be pulled out and thrown into an unclean place outside the city.
passages.sermon:
The priest returns on the seventh day.
The priest inspects the house.
If the mildew has spread on the walls, the priest gives an order.
Workers must remove the stones that have mildew.
They must throw these stones outside the city.
They must put the stones in an unclean place.
passages.original: וְשָׁ֥ב הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑י וְרָאָ֕ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בְּקִירֹ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת׃ וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְחִלְּצוּ֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֲבָנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִשְׁלִ֤יכוּ אֶתְהֶן֙ אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר אֶל־ מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא׃

passages.text: And he shall have the inside of the house scraped completely and the plaster that is scraped off dumped into an unclean place outside the city.
passages.sermon:
The priest examines a house for mildew.
He finds mildew on the walls.
He orders the inside of the house to be scraped all around.
Workers scrape off the plaster from the walls.
They collect the scraped plaster and dust.
They take the plaster and dust outside the city.
They dump it in an unclean place.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַבַּ֛יִת יַקְצִ֥עַ מִבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֑יב וְשָׁפְכ֗וּ אֶת־ הֶֽעָפָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְצ֔וּ אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר אֶל־ מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא׃

passages.text: So different stones must be obtained to replace the contaminated ones, as well as additional mortar to replaster the house.
passages.sermon:
The priest inspects a house for mildew.
\r\nIf the house has contaminated stones, people must remove them.
\r\nThey must bring new stones.
\r\nThey must put the new stones where the old, contaminated stones were.
\r\nThey must take new mortar.
\r\nThey must replaster the house with the new mortar.
passages.original: וְלָקְחוּ֙ אֲבָנִ֣ים אֲחֵר֔וֹת וְהֵבִ֖יאוּ אֶל־ תַּ֣חַת הָאֲבָנִ֑ים וְעָפָ֥ר אַחֵ֛ר יִקַּ֖ח וְטָ֥ח אֶת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: If the mildew reappears in the house after the stones have been torn out and the house has been scraped and replastered, the priest must come and inspect it. If the mildew has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew; the house is unclean.
passages.sermon:
A priest inspects a house for mildew.
Workers have already removed the affected stones from the house.
They have scraped the house.
They have replastered the house.
If mildew appears again in the house, the priest comes to look at it.
If the mildew has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew.
The house is unclean.
passages.original: וְאִם־ יָשׁ֤וּב הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ וּפָרַ֣ח בַּבַּ֔יִת אַחַ֖ר חִלֵּ֣ץ אֶת־ הָאֲבָנִ֑ים וְאַחֲרֵ֛י הִקְצ֥וֹת אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת וְאַחֲרֵ֥י הִטּֽוֹחַ׃ וּבָא֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְרָאָ֕ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בַּבָּ֑יִת צָרַ֨עַת מַמְאֶ֥רֶת הִ֛וא בַּבַּ֖יִת טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃

passages.text: It must be torn down with its stones, its timbers, and all its plaster, and taken outside the city to an unclean place.
passages.sermon:
The house is unclean.
The house must be torn down.
Workers must remove its stones.
Workers must remove its timbers.
Workers must remove all its plaster.
They must take all these materials outside the city.
They must bring them to an unclean place.
passages.original: וְנָתַ֣ץ אֶת־ הַבַּ֗יִת אֶת־ אֲבָנָיו֙ וְאֶת־ עֵצָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ עֲפַ֣ר הַבָּ֑יִת וְהוֹצִיא֙ אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר אֶל־ מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא׃

passages.text: Anyone who enters the house during any of the days that it is closed up will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A person may enter a house that has been closed up because of mildew.
The house is under inspection for impurity.
Anyone who enters the house during this time becomes unclean.
This impurity lasts until evening.
passages.original: וְהַבָּא֙ אֶל־ הַבַּ֔יִת כָּל־ יְמֵ֖י הִסְגִּ֣יר אֹת֑וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: And anyone who sleeps in the house or eats in it must wash his clothes.
passages.sermon: Anyone who sleeps in the house must wash his clothes.\r\nAnyone who eats in the house must wash his clothes.
passages.original: וְהַשֹּׁכֵ֣ב בַּבַּ֔יִת יְכַבֵּ֖ס אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֑יו וְהָאֹכֵ֣ל בַּבַּ֔יִת יְכַבֵּ֖ס אֶת־ בְּגָדָֽיו׃

passages.text: If, however, the priest comes and inspects it, and the mildew has not spread after the house has been replastered, he shall pronounce the house clean, because the mildew is gone.
passages.sermon:
A priest is a person who serves God and leads the people in worship.
The priest comes to the house.
He inspects the house.
He looks for mildew in the house.
The house has been replastered.
The priest sees that the mildew has not spread.
The mildew is gone.
The priest pronounces the house clean.
passages.original: וְאִם־ בֹּ֨א יָבֹ֜א הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְרָאָה֙ וְ֠הִנֵּה לֹא־ פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת אַחֲרֵ֖י הִטֹּ֣חַ אֶת־ הַבָּ֑יִת וְטִהַ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת כִּ֥י נִרְפָּ֖א הַנָּֽגַע׃

passages.text: He is to take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop to purify the house; and he shall slaughter one of the birds over fresh water in a clay pot.
passages.sermon:
The priest must purify a house that had mildew.
He must take two birds.
He must take cedar wood.
He must take scarlet yarn.
He must take hyssop.
He must use these items to make the house clean.
He must slaughter one of the birds.
He must kill the bird over fresh water.
He must use a clay pot to hold the water.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֛ח לְחַטֵּ֥א אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת שְׁתֵּ֣י צִפֳּרִ֑ים וְעֵ֣ץ אֶ֔רֶז וּשְׁנִ֥י תוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֵזֹֽב׃ וְשָׁחַ֖ט אֶת־ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הָאֶחָ֑ת אֶל־ כְּלִי־ חֶ֖רֶשׂ עַל־ מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: Then he shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet yarn, and the live bird, dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird and the fresh water, and sprinkle the house seven times.
passages.sermon:
The priest must take cedar wood.
He must take hyssop.
He must take scarlet yarn.
He must take the live bird.
He must dip all these in the blood of the bird that was killed.
He must also dip them in the fresh water.
He must sprinkle the house seven times.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֣ח אֶת־ עֵֽץ־ הָ֠אֶרֶז וְאֶת־ הָ֨אֵזֹ֜ב וְאֵ֣ת׀ שְׁנִ֣י הַתּוֹלַ֗עַת וְאֵת֮ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽחַיָּה֒ וְטָבַ֣ל אֹתָ֗ם בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַשְּׁחוּטָ֔ה וּבַמַּ֖יִם הַֽחַיִּ֑ים וְהִזָּ֥ה אֶל־ הַבַּ֖יִת שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים׃

passages.text: And he shall cleanse the house with the bird’s blood, the fresh water, the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop, and the scarlet yarn.
passages.sermon:
A priest must cleanse a house that was unclean.
He uses the blood of a bird.
He uses fresh water.
He uses a live bird.
He uses cedar wood.
He uses hyssop.
He uses scarlet yarn.
He cleanses the house with all these things.
passages.original: וְחִטֵּ֣א אֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפּ֔וֹר וּבַמַּ֖יִם הַֽחַיִּ֑ים וּבַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַחַיָּ֗ה וּבְעֵ֥ץ הָאֶ֛רֶז וּבָאֵזֹ֖ב וּבִשְׁנִ֥י הַתּוֹלָֽעַת׃

passages.text: Finally, he is to release the live bird into the open fields outside the city. In this way he will make atonement for the house, and it will be clean.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes the live bird.
He releases the live bird.
He sends the bird outside the city.
He lets the bird go into the open fields.
The priest makes atonement for the house.
The house becomes clean.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּ֞ח אֶת־ הַצִּפֹּ֧ר הַֽחַיָּ֛ה אֶל־ מִח֥וּץ לָעִ֖יר אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עַל־ הַבַּ֖יִת וְטָהֵֽר׃

passages.text: This is the law for any infectious skin disease, for a scaly outbreak, for mildew in clothing or in a house, and for a swelling, rash, or spot, to determine when something is clean or unclean. This is the law regarding skin diseases and mildew.”
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel through Moses and Aaron.
These laws explain how to handle skin diseases.
These laws also cover scaly outbreaks.
These laws include mildew in clothing.
These laws include mildew in a house.
These laws cover any swelling.
These laws cover any rash.
These laws cover any spot.
These laws help people know when something is unclean.
These laws help people know when something is clean.
These are the laws about skin diseases and mildew.
passages.original: זֹ֖את הַתּוֹרָ֑ה לְכָל־ נֶ֥גַע הַצָּרַ֖עַת וְלַנָּֽתֶק׃ וּלְצָרַ֥עַת הַבֶּ֖גֶד וְלַבָּֽיִת׃ וְלַשְׂאֵ֥ת וְלַסַּפַּ֖חַת וְלַבֶּהָֽרֶת׃ לְהוֹרֹ֕ת בְּי֥וֹם הַטָּמֵ֖א וּבְי֣וֹם הַטָּהֹ֑ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַצָּרָֽעַת׃ס
